cues.text: Asks for your UPI PIN to receive money. A PIN is only ever needed to send money.
patterns: \bpin\b.*(receive|get the amount|accept|money will come|பெற|வரும்|வந்த|पाने|पैसे आ|आ जाएँगे)

cues.text: Asks you to share an OTP, card number or CVV.
Threatens to block, suspend or disconnect, or mentions police / FIR.
Asks you to pay a fee first to get a prize, loan, job or parcel.
Asks you to install a screen-sharing app (AnyDesk, TeamViewer).
Claims you won a prize or lucky draw.
Asks you to scan a QR code to receive money.
Claims money was sent to you by mistake and asks for it back.
patterns: (by mistake|wrong number|sent .* to you by mistake)

cues.text: Offers easy money for simple tasks or part-time work.
patterns: (part time job|work from home|daily income|simple tasks|like youtube)
